title: The gnu's shop: README
subtitle: Written by everyone who fixed it, because I never did. – G.

sections.heading: Fortune Machine
sections.body: Five phrase banks feed the printer, one line each. Each ink tube goes to the nozzle with its letter. Print, dry, send down the chute.

sections.heading: Cookie Machine
sections.body: Dry first, then wet, then mix and rest. The motor controller turns the mixer. The press thumps with the conveyor's beat.

sections.heading: Oven
sections.body: Five heat zones bake the rounds through the tunnel. Each thermostat lead goes to the port its sticker names. Bake, drop the fortune, fold warm, cool, package.

sections.heading: Cookie Machine to Oven
sections.body: Belt at 3 cm a second. One round every 5 seconds. A fresh bowl every 2 minutes. Every round comes out golden.

sections.heading: Fortune Machine to Oven
sections.body: Print every 4 ticks, dry for 1, start at tick 0. With the 2-tick chute, every fortune lands as the arms fold.

sections.heading: Oven to packaging
sections.body: Chute 1, extra crisp, to Seagull's rooftop basket. Chute 2, golden, to the teahouse tins. Chute 3, soft, to Crab's pier crate. Gopher takes it from there.

closing.heading: Maintainers
closing.line: Not one gnu. All of you:
closing.fortune: You figured out what I never wrote down. It's yours now. – G.
